project.name: MECHNOVA // AUTONOMOUS PLATFORM
project.description: Production-grade Autonomous Robotics Hackathon Quiz & Theme-Bidding Platform for VIT Chennai

environment.styling: Tailwind CSS v3 + Vanilla CSS with Google Fonts (Syne, Outfit, JetBrains Mono)
environment.graphics: Three.js 3D Wireframe Mesh (Icosahedron, Torus, Octahedron, Horizon Grid) & Stardust Particle Constellation
environment.stateManagement: React Context API (AuthContext, EventContext) + Authoritative Cloud / Client Engines

usage.background: #110515 (Deep Midnight Plum Void) and #000000 (Pure Black Depth)
usage.primaryButtons: #68388D (Cosmic Purple) with hover #855AB4 and orchid glow
usage.statusPills: Green (#10B981) for Open, Red (#EF4444) for Closed, Orchid (#B26FCB) for Active

quizEngine.scoring: 100 points per correct answer, 0 for incorrect
quizEngine.clockSync: Authoritative timestamp delta calculation via NTP server offset

themeRevealEngine.revealMechanism: Atomic transition from private storage to public collection with audit logging

defaultThemes.brief: Deliver inverse kinematics models, simulated ROS2 nodes, and latency benchmarking.
Must include inference profiling under 15ms and confidence calibration.

defaultThemes.publicName: Industrial PLC Logic & Deterministic SCADA Automation
defaultThemes.brief: Requires structured text definitions, safety interlock proofs, and telemetry dashboards.
Must demonstrate consensus retention during 40% packet degradation.

biddingAndAllocation.allocationLock: Deterministic greedy allocation based on prioritized queue

cmsEngine.scope: Controls all titles, subtitles, badges, metrics, domains, phases, navbar brand, links, and footer
